/funplay-originals/organic-play/kukura.h.description: Kukura is a rooster-shaped spring rider from our Organic Play collection, painted in black, yellow and green. It takes the plain spring rider and gives it a bird with character, which young children respond to straight away. A child sits on the rooster, holds on and rocks it back and forth, which is all the imagination play a three-year-old needs. It is meant for ages 3 to 8. Spring riders take very little ground, so Kukura can fill a gap beside a bench or near a toddler slide. The roto-moulded body has a 3-year warranty and the spring a 1-year warranty. Tell us how many riders you need and we will place them on your drawing.
/funplay-originals/organic-play/kukura.h.spec_paragraph: Kukura mounts on a steel spring that is fixed self-standing or grouted, depending on the ground. Give it space on all sides, because a spring rider tilts in every direction. Check the spring, handles and footrests at each service, and replace the spring under its 1-year cover if it shows a defect.

/funplay-originals/organic-play/monstera.description: Monstera is a twin-tower play station whose frames copy the curved, split leaves of the monstera plant. The cut-outs let light and sight lines through, so parents can watch children on the upper levels. From above, four Lemon Yellow slides spread out in an X, one from each corner of the towers. Four slides let a large group come down at once, which is useful in a school or a big society park. It suits ages 5 to 12 and holds up to 15 children. The product area is 24' x 20'4" and the safe play area is 30' x 26'4". Climbing and sliding here build body strength and imagination. The 3-year warranty applies to galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Ask us for a quote.
/funplay-originals/organic-play/monstera.spec_paragraph: Monstera's leaf frames are composite on a galvanised pipe structure, with roto-moulded slides. It is installed self-standing or grouted. Each of the four slide exits needs its own run-out space within the 30' x 26'4" zone, so square sites suit it best. Check every slide joint and the leaf panel edges at regular intervals.

/funplay-originals/organic-play/pachkili.description: Pachkili is a parrot-faced play tower in yellow and green that works as a small circuit. Children climb a curved net climber, crawl through a tube tunnel and slide back down, then run round to start again. The name and the face come from the parrot, and the loop keeps children moving from one activity to the next. Up to 15 children aged 5 to 12 can play on it. At 13'4" x 4'5", with a safe play area of 18'4" x 8'5", it is narrow enough for a side lawn or a school corridor of open ground. Climbing and crawling build upper body strength and spatial awareness. We cover the main materials for 3 years. Measure the strip you have in mind and we will tell you if it fits.
/funplay-originals/organic-play/pachkili.spec_paragraph: Pachkili's tower is galvanised pipe with a roto-moulded tube tunnel and a play rope climbing net. It can go in self-standing or grouted. Lay impact flooring under the curved net and at the slide exit inside the 18'4" x 8'5" zone. Check the tunnel joints and net tension during routine servicing.
flags: No catalogue entry; website height value is 'NA cm'. The current description spells it 'Pachakili'.
Activities list 'Sliding' but images mention only a tunnel and net climber. Confirm a slide is included.

/funplay-originals/organic-play/shinga.h.description: Shinga is a pair of spiral climbers shaped like a bull's horns, facing each other across a wavy balance path that forms the head. Children climb up a horn from either side, meet in the middle and cross over, so two groups play towards each other. The photos show it in Play Orange on a grass mound, and Cherry Red is also offered. The age range is 5 to 12, with room for 15 children. The climber is long and narrow, 22'10" x 4'9", with a safe play area of 27'10" x 9'9". Climbing and balancing build interaction and parallel play. Its galvanised pipe and moulded parts carry our 3-year warranty. Ask us whether a mound or a flat base suits your site.
/funplay-originals/organic-play/shinga.h.spec_paragraph: Shinga's horns are galvanised pipe spirals with roto-moulded and composite parts on the balance path. It is installed self-standing or grouted, and a grass mound needs a firm concrete footing beneath. Keep impact flooring or soft ground along both horns, and inspect the spiral joints and balance path regularly.

/funplay-originals/organic-play/toucan.h.description: Toucan is a bird-shaped play structure built for children who like to climb back up the slide. Its green arch climber forms the back, a red tail rises at one end, a yellow beak panel marks the head, and a blue slide runs down from the top. A climbing net and arch rungs lead up, and children jump, slide and climb again in quick loops. It is planned for 5 to 12 year olds and a group of up to 15. The product area is 20'9" x 5'8", so it fits a narrow strip. Play here builds social interaction and observation. The structure comes in multiple colours and has a 3-year warranty on pipe, roto-moulded parts, laminates and rope. Ask us to mark its safe zone on your plan.
/funplay-originals/organic-play/toucan.h.spec_paragraph: Toucan is built on a galvanised pipe arch with roto-moulded panels and a play rope net. It is fixed self-standing or grouted. Children jump off it as well as slide, so lay impact flooring along the full length and on both sides. Check the arch rungs and slide exit regularly.
flags: Safe play area 25'9" x 4'8" is narrower than the product area width 5'8" (same in catalogue). Left out of the copy; confirm the correct width.

/funplay-originals/organic-play/unt-sava.description: Unt Savari is a camel spring rider in Mango Yellow that brings a desert ride into the play park. The hump at the back pops up as the camel rocks, which makes the ride feel closer to sitting on a real camel. It is designed for ages 3 to 8. The rider is small, with a product area of 3'9" x 1'6" and a safe play area of 7'9" x 5'6". Two or three can sit in a row beside a toddler area. Riding it builds imagination and creativity in the youngest children. Like Kukura, it comes from our Organic Play collection. The roto-moulded body has our 3-year warranty, and the spring has a 1-year warranty. Ask us for a drawing with riders placed on your site.
/funplay-originals/organic-play/unt-sava.spec_paragraph: Unt Savari sits on a steel spring that is installed self-standing or grouted. Leave the full 7'9" x 5'6" zone clear, and do not place two riders so close that their safe zones overlap. The spring and moving hump should be checked at every service, since springs and moving parts carry a 1-year warranty.
flags: Subtitle missing (null). Suggest 'Spring Rider'. Capacity '15' implausible for a single spring rider; left out.

/funplay-originals/timeless-play/chausar.description: Chausar takes the old board game of chausar and lays it out as a playground. The cross-shaped structure has a central tower at the meeting point and four arms with slides and climbers, each arm in its own colour. A team of four can each take a colour and race to the top, or children can make up their own rules. Chausar is sized for ages 5 to 12, with a capacity of 15 children. The product area is 34'7" x 27'5", with a safe play area of 40'7" x 33'5", so it needs a large park or school ground. Climbing, hanging, crawling, balancing and sliding build agility, body strength, strategy and confidence. Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope carry a 3-year warranty. Call us to discuss your ground.
/funplay-originals/timeless-play/chausar.spec_paragraph: Chausar is our largest Timeless Play structure, so the 40'7" x 33'5" safe zone usually decides where it can go. It is fixed self-standing or grouted, and a patterned safety surface can carry the board game theme across the ground. Check each arm's slide and climber fixings on a regular schedule.

/funplay-originals/timeless-play/fugadi..description: Fugadi is a revolving play pole named after fugdi, the spinning game played in Maharashtra and Goa. A tall pole in Play Red and Baby Blue carries four handgrips on ropes near the top. Children hold a grip each and move round the pole in rhythm, almost like a dance, instead of sitting on a spinning seat. It is designed for ages 5 to 12, and the game works for boys and girls alike. Revolving and balancing build arm strength, spatial awareness and balance. The pole stands on a round black base and takes very little ground. It belongs to our Timeless Play collection. The galvanised pipe and roto-moulded parts carry our 3-year warranty. Ask us how much clear space to allow around it.
/funplay-originals/timeless-play/fugadi..spec_paragraph: Fugadi revolves on bearings at the top of the pole, which carry a 1-year warranty and should be checked at each service. The pole is galvanised pipe with roto-moulded parts, fixed self-standing or grouted. Children swing outward while holding the grips, so keep a wide circle around the pole free of benches.

/funplay-originals/timeless-play/paheli..description: Paheli is a puzzle-themed play structure where jigsaw pieces become the climbing route. A purple puzzle tower stands at the centre, puzzle-shaped climbers lead up its sides, and a huge puzzle piece at the back gives another way to the top. Two slides, one yellow and one orange, bring children down. Working out which piece to climb next builds problem solving and concentration. It is meant for ages 5 to 12 and takes up to 15 children. The product area is 21'7" x 12'10" and the safe play area is 27'7" x 17'10". Climbing, hanging and sliding also build upper body strength. It comes in a multi-colour finish. The structure has a 3-year warranty on its main materials. Send us your site photos.
/funplay-originals/timeless-play/paheli..spec_paragraph: Paheli's puzzle climbers are composite and roto-moulded parts on a galvanised pipe frame. It is fixed self-standing or grouted. Children hang from the puzzle edges, so keep impact flooring beneath every climber, not only at the slides. Inspect the puzzle panel fixings and the two slide joints regularly.

/funplay-originals/timeless-play/patang..description: Patang is a kite swing set. An arched frame joins four kite sections with a loop climber, and from the front the whole thing reads as one kite. Coloured kite panels catch the light as children swing on the orange seats or climb through the hanging rings. It suits ages 5 to 12. The product area is 14'11" x 5'9", but the safe play area is much larger at 24'11" x 19'9", because swings need clear space front and back. Swinging, climbing and hanging build arm strength, flexibility and concentration. The colours are multi-colour. Its galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts and composite laminates are covered for 3 years. Ask us for a layout that shows the full swing zone.
/funplay-originals/timeless-play/patang..spec_paragraph: Patang's arch frame is galvanised pipe with composite kite panels and roto-moulded seats. It is installed self-standing or grouted. The swing arc sets the 24'11" x 19'9" zone, so keep paths and other equipment outside it. Bearings and spare parts carry a 1-year warranty and should be checked at each visit.
flags: Capacity '15' implausible for a swing set; left out of the copy.

/funplay-originals/wall-play/dahi-handi..description: Dahi Handi is a figure climber modelled on the human pyramid formed during Janmashtami. Six stylised human figures in different colours stand on each other's shoulders, and children climb up the figures themselves rather than a rock wall or net. Short pegs on each figure act as hand and foot holds. The idea teaches children to find their own route and to climb with care. It suits ages 5 to 12. The base footprint is small, 2'2" x 1'4", with a safe play area of 8'2" x 4'4". Climbing, hanging and balancing build physical fitness, coordination, balance and critical thinking. It is part of our Wall Play collection. The galvanised pipe and moulded parts carry a 3-year warranty. Ask us for a quote.
/funplay-originals/wall-play/dahi-handi..spec_paragraph: Dahi Handi is installed self-standing or grouted, and a firm footing matters because children climb to the top figure. Lay impact flooring across the whole 8'2" x 4'4" zone. Check the hand pegs and the joints between figures for looseness during routine inspection.

/funplay-originals/wall-play/geoboard.ht.description: Geo Board is a long play panel in Sand Beige set with pegs, where children stretch string between the pegs to make shapes. It works like the classroom geoboard at a size children can climb on and hang from. A group can stand along it and each make their own pattern, or work together on one picture. It suits ages 5 to 12. The panel is 19'8" long but only 1'5" deep, with a safe play area of 23'8" x 4'5", so it can line a wall or divide two play zones. Play here builds visual thinking, critical thinking and upper body strength, and children of different abilities can use it side by side. It carries a 3-year warranty. Ask us where it fits.
/funplay-originals/wall-play/geoboard.ht.spec_paragraph: Geo Board is a composite panel on a galvanised pipe frame, installed self-standing or grouted. Because it is so thin, it can run along a boundary wall without blocking a path. Check the pegs and replace worn string during routine maintenance, and keep soft flooring below where children climb.
flags: No catalogue entry. Capacity '15' looks high for a single panel.

/funplay-originals/wall-play/ghar-ghar.h.description: Ghar Ghar is a play house built partly into a wall, a twist on the tree house for sites that are short of space. The purple house has a yellow slide and a tube tunnel, and children climb up, sit inside, crawl through and slide out. It suits city societies and schools where every square foot of open ground counts. The play house is designed for ages 5 to 12 and takes up to 15 children. The product area is 15'2" x 13'7" and the safe play area is 20'2" x 16'7". Climbing, hanging, sliding and sitting build physical fitness and exploration. The listed colour is Mango Yellow. Our 3-year warranty covers its pipes, moulded parts, laminates and rope. Send us a photo of your wall.
/funplay-originals/wall-play/ghar-ghar.h.spec_paragraph: Ghar Ghar is galvanised pipe with composite and roto-moulded parts, and it can be installed self-standing or grouted. Where it is set against a wall, our layout drawing checks clearance on the open sides. Clean inside the house and tunnel regularly, and inspect the slide joint and wall fixings at each service.
flags: Colour listed as Mango Yellow but images show a purple house with a yellow slide. Two image descriptions are identical.
Subtitle 'Play Panel' does not describe a play house with slide and tunnel.

/funplay-originals/wall-play/udanchu.htm.description: Udanchu is a giant fly scaled up for children to climb, with net wings on either side of a Play Yellow body and a yellow slide. Children climb over the wings and look closely at their patterns, then slide down from the top. The design asks children to notice and observe small creatures. School-age children from 5 to 12 use it, up to 15 together. The product area is 10' x 14'10" and the safe play area is 16' x 17'10", a compact size for a school garden or nature trail. Climbing, hanging and sliding build upper body strength, coordination and parallel play. A 3-year warranty covers the galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope. Call +91 902 830 2266 for a layout drawing.
/funplay-originals/wall-play/udanchu.htm.spec_paragraph: Udanchu's body is galvanised pipe with roto-moulded parts, and the wings are play rope nets. It is installed self-standing or grouted. Children climb across both wings, so impact flooring is needed under each side as well as at the slide. Check net tension and wing fixings during regular maintenance.
